description: Look up an Indian six-digit PIN code: the post offices that use it (with India Post taluk), the state, and the district (the current district from the Local Government Directory where it can be matched safely by Census 2011 code, otherwise India Post's own label, which says which). Source: India Post office list via GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) and the Local Government Directory (GODL). Post offices change: it is a snapshot.
name: lookup_pin
title: India PIN code to post offices, district and state
